Team / Alicia — I reviewed the Section 8.2 request. Summary:

- ClearWave wants explicit in-country residency for production data. Our standard MSA allows customer-specific residency controls via an appendix; we can accept a targeted residency carveout limited to non-PII analytics.
- Proposed language change: replace the global residency sentence with an appendix reference plus a short operational controls table (encryption at rest + region-limited hosting).
- If legal agrees, we'll mark the MSA as "MSA redlines agreed in principle" and include the operations appendix to be finalized during onboarding. That keeps the commercial terms intact while giving procurement the assurance they need.

I've uploaded a redlined doc (Redlines_MSA_CW.docx) to the shared drive and included comments on the appendix approach. Key open question for ClearWave: will they accept an operations appendix instead of a blanket residency guarantee?

Owner: laura_bennett@redwood.com — deliver redline doc (done) and review call availability next Wed 6/9 or Thu 6/10.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
